Corvisquire

Flying

Galar · Generation 8

Corvisquire is a Flying-type Raven Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 16 kg. It evolves from Rookidee and into Corviknight. Its highest base stat is Speed (77), with a base stat total of 365.
